title_zh: 重要的是接下来发生的
content_zh: 公共项目“重要的是接下来发生的”呈现了一系列艺术作品和现场活动，探讨照护的源头，以及“去照护”和“被照护”之间的状态转变。一场由The People Speak 主持的圆桌对话探索了日常照护行动的面貌。艺术家Youngsook Choi 和 Eva Freeman 进入艺术中心隔壁的Spring Grove 康养院，与那里的居住者一起开展工作坊，并以期间产生的对话内容与手工创作为素材，制作了现场表演《照护之环》。另一位艺术家Luccy Steggals 则组织了一次花园工作坊，邀请参与者在布料的触感中探索身体得到照护的轻柔时刻，以及我们与物体、地点和他人的亲密关系。
content_en: Public programme 'It Matters What Happens Next' at Camden Art Centre featured a series of artworks and live events, considering the origins of care and the transition between states of 'caring' to being 'cared for' by others. A roundtable conversation led by The People Speak was set to explore what everyday acts of care look like today. Artists Youngsook Choi and Eva Freeman worked with the residents from Spring Grove Care Home, adjoining Camden Art Centre, to generate workshops. The resulting conversations and handmade elements were delivered as a live performance 'Circle of Care'. Another garden workshop led by artist Lucy Steggals invited participants to explore the tacility of textile-based materials, considering the tender moment of care for the body and our intimate relations with objects, places and people.
